verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a free migration app that automates moving code and users from Bitbucket Server/Data Center to Cloud, plus a Cloud Premium trial matching existing Data Center license terms, directly addressing self-hosted-to-cloud migration. Missing for 10: evidence of migration tooling from other platforms (e.g., GitHub/GitLab), independent/hands-on validation of the migration app's reliability, and details on user/permission migration fidelity.
